title: Version comparison (sessions vs. errors)
sqlTemplate: select version, count(distinct session_id) as sessions, count(distinct case when type = 'error' then session_id end) as sessions_with_error from _rumdata where service = {{service}} and env = {{environment}} group by version order by sessions desc limit 20
emptyDataSemantics: No matching records -> an empty result set (zero rows), not a zero-valued row.
